registration_status: No securely matching archaeological controls in the 10m imagery
notes: Citadel and lower town located by published area plan. No imagery line can be tied securely to a particular ancient face at 10m. Two measured plan sources have unspecified north. The granary drawing is graphic and orthogonal; its zero deviation is plan-relative. DK-G North has a separate measured system. No registration controls resolve the individual wall faces.
error_scope: Tool sigma preserved. Unspecified plan arrows leave true north unresolved. Shared north-arrow error, survey and paper distortion are outside an independence interpretation of the system SE.
